scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: Proof is a synthesis of published maturity and graph-construction theorems; no computation or independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.limitations: Does not prove the full maturity classification for graphs with cut vertices or 2-vertex separators.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Finite simple 3-vertex-connected nonplanar graphs; ordered collision-free two-point configuration spaces; integral first homology.
